title: AI doesn't need more speed. It needs a standard.
lede: Raw AI generates from scratch every time. Fonderie gives it a shared, audited vocabulary — so it composes, not hallucinates.

features.title: Backend intelligence
features.text: Auth, billing, permissions, workspaces — each a typed, tested state machine. Not a template; a building block that runs in your process, against your database.

features.title: Screen kits
features.text: AI generates your login, billing, and team screens. Pre-built, accessible, secure — wired to your backend automatically.

features.title: AI-readable skills
features.text: Skill files in your repo spell out how backend modules and frontend screens wire together. No prompt engineering. No drift between sessions.

features.title: Community registry
features.text: A registry of screens built by the community. Grab a shadcn login, a billing portal, or build your own. The intelligence is shared; the UI is yours.

codeFooter: Every module exposes the same contract, so composition is a lookup — not a guess.
